value.rationale: Determines the complete exact maximum-versus-near-maximum BWT run distribution and structural criterion for the minimal nontrivial Parikh class with one repeated letter. This refines a newly studied unclustered BWT enumeration question and gives a non-obvious universal probability independent of repeated-letter rank; meaningful infinite natural invariant despite no general Parikh-vector theorem.
